.gitignore.finding: Explicitly excludes live DBs and WAL/SHM/journals, runtime locks/logs, environment secrets/keys/credentials/tokens, user-specific configs, models, generated screenshots/vector data and runtime caches while retaining designated seed/reference DB paths. Strong historical evidence for separating source/reference state from live mutable/personal state.

install.sh.finding: Installs dependencies, auto-detects CPU/CUDA/Vulkan, creates separate venvs, builds llama.cpp and whisper.cpp, downloads models, writes/enables many systemd user services, desktop integration and starts runtime. Later lineage explicitly says Ollama removed and vision uses adaptive pipeline. Executable deployment knowledge, not current Clay 0.1 architecture contract.

_bootstrap.py.finding: Minimal deterministic sys.path bootstrap for scripts launched outside package context.

install_wizard.py.finding: Rich/PyInstaller-aware wrapper around install.sh. Stale against installer: expects [1/14]..[14/14], retains Ollama/Vision and older model inventory, while install.sh emits 13-step markers, explicitly removes Ollama, and uses [10/13] twice. Progress synchronization cannot be trusted without repair.

test_frank.py.finding: Contains only literal 41-byte line 'Hello from Frank — build-script works!'; not executable pytest coverage and must never be counted as architecture/test coverage.

.gitlab-ci.yml.finding: Local-runner GitLab Docker-in-Docker pipeline builds CPU first then CUDA and Vulkan images, uses shallow fetch, sequential GPU stage and retry logic to reduce OOM/network failures.

Dockerfile.finding: Ubuntu 24.04 multi-stage image compiles llama.cpp and whisper.cpp, supports CPU/CUDA/Vulkan build args, creates non-root frank runtime user, separate data/config/model paths, seed DB copy, healthcheck and explicit service ports. Historical FRANK_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0 and broad exposed port surface require current threat-model review rather than blind inheritance.

.dockerignore.finding: Excludes VCS/cache/runtime DB/WAL/SHM, local env/config, compose/CI, IDE and build artifacts from Docker context while retaining .env.example.

docker-compose.vulkan.yml.finding: Selects Vulkan backend, maps /dev/dri and video/render groups and uses Vulkan-tagged image.

docker-compose.cuda.yml.finding: Selects NVIDIA CUDA 12.6 builder/runtime and requests one GPU through Compose deploy resources.

docker-compose.yml.finding: Defines CPU default runtime, persistent model/data/voice volumes and maps Core/WebUI/Router/Search/Toolbox/Reflector/AURA/Physics/LLM/Whisper/Micro-LLM ports to host while FRANK_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0. Useful topology archaeology; externally reachable bindings must not be inherited without explicit authority/network controls.

titan.db.finding: Exact raw file is 0 bytes. Filename is provenance only; contains no Titan schema or persisted state.

consciousness.db.finding: Exact raw file is 0 bytes. Filename is provenance only; contains no consciousness schema or persisted state.

install-wizard.spec.finding: Bundles install_wizard.py, install.sh and rich assets into console executable frank-installer.

pyproject.toml.finding: Declares project-frankenstein 1.0.0, Python >=3.10, MIT, pytest test discovery and Ruff E/F/W policy. Does not prove tests pass or specify full runtime dependency graph.

config.yaml.example.finding: Documents path/GPU/backend/service-port/UI/voice/privacy configuration and older Ollama+LLaVA vision assumptions. Conflicts with later install.sh explicitly removing Ollama for adaptive vision; preserve as superseded topology/config lineage, not current truth.

cross_file_findings.detail: Wizard parses 14-step markers while installer emits 13-step markers and duplicates [10/13]; wizard also retains obsolete Ollama/Vision/model descriptions. Reproducible installer-progress regression test.
Older config/wizard retains Ollama vision lineage; later install.sh states Ollama removed and adaptive vision used. Preserve chronology; do not merge into one current architecture claim.
Historical container sets FRANK_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0 and publishes many service ports. Current Clay 0.1 must mediate exposure with explicit network/authority policy.
pytest discovery config exists, but root test_frank.py is only a text smoke marker. Do not infer functional test coverage from filename.
Historical packaging distinguishes live mutable DB/WAL state from source/seed/reference state; root DB names themselves are empty placeholders and supply no state payload.
